Record Class OffscreenButtons.Draw

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.OffscreenButtons.Draw
Record Components:
minecraft - current client
x - left edge
y - top edge
width - button width
height - button height
state - current visual state
options - retained live button options
Enclosing class:
OffscreenButtons
public static record OffscreenButtons.Draw(net.minecraft.client.Minecraft minecraft, int x, int y, int width, int height, OffscreenButtons.State state, OffscreenButtons.Builder options) extends Record
One button draw. Both vanilla and ModularUI adapters supply the same geometry and interaction information.
